name: The Heart of the Earth
source:
Two soldiers are stuck together in a trench. And none of them are sane, that's for sure. They pursue different goals — but what would be left of their hopes when the field phone rings... for the first time in two years?

[from [url=https://horseless-knight.itch.io/the-heart-of-the-earth]itch.io[/url]]
